company.name: Hatom Labs
company.shortDescription: Hatom Labs is a decentralized finance platform on MultiversX offering lending, borrowing, liquid staking, and stablecoin services.
company.description: Hatom Protocol is a decentralized, algorithmic protocol for lending and borrowing assets that operates on the Elrond Network. Hatom is a decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem built on the MultiversX blockchain, designed to provide secure, scalable, and non-custodial financial services. Launched in 2023, Hatom became the first liquidity protocol on MultiversX, offering a complete suite of DeFi products including lending and borrowing, liquid staking, native stablecoins, staking modules, and cross-chain interoperability solutions. The platform focuses on building sustainable and secure decentralized financial infrastructure while improving liquidity and capital efficiency across the MultiversX ecosystem.
